analysis.title: GS Polley - Credit PT / ETF / TRS Commentary 10.10.26
key_insights: Interest rate volatility is at 6-month highs while stocks approach all-time highs. Multiple idiosyncratic situations are driving IG and HY technicals.

Treasury supply was absorbed. The 10y reopening printed 1.6 bps through and the 30y auction tailed 0.2 bp, even though the 30y came into the auction 5 bps richer. Trump's announcement of a suspension of attacks on Iran drove stocks higher.

In Europe, an initial move on French public deficit concerns and a flight to quality stabilized. Xover ended the week 2 bps tighter and the 10y OAT/Bund spread closed at +137.5 bps, about 2 bps tighter on the week.
US cash credit is decompressing. The HYG - 3x LQD spread reached its widest level since May.

HY PT desk flow shows the quality split. Clients were 2.4:1 net buyers of BB paper versus 1.4:1 net buyers of CCC paper. In notional terms that is $2.09bn net client buying of BB against $53mm of CCC.

In US IG, reports of new and growing chip financing deals and headlines about lower-than-expected OpenAI revenue pushed beta hyperscaler names wider. Strong supply technicals in generic IG pulled non-hyperscaler cash tighter.
The GS IG 30y Hyperscaler Basket vs. IG 30y A and Up Ex-Hyperscaler Basket spread reached its widest level since July, up 7.4 bps on the week.
The PT desk fielded $28.1bn in inquiry across 388 inquiries, with an average PT size of $76mm. Flows were 1.3:1 client selling by dv01 in IG and 2.3:1 client buying by notional in HY.
The IG100 moved 3 bps tighter despite balanced-to-selling IG PT flow. The desk attributes the move to broader macro strength rather than improving credit fundamentals.
Across the IG curve, clients traded the front end balanced and were better sellers of the intermediate and back end. By rating, clients were equally better sellers in all IG buckets.
HY felt firm, with 10+ buy agendas above 100mm. BB-concentrated agendas made up all of the client buy flow, while the BWICs were lower-quality, single-B-heavy lists.
Bid-offer widened notably. The average clearing level on $100mm+ PTs screened 2-3x wider than normal.
Weekly PT inquiry by maturity: HY clients bought across all buckets (1.9:1 in 0-3y, 2.4:1 in 3-7y and 7-15y, only buyers in 15y+). IG clients sold 1.3:1 in 3-7y, 1.6:1 in 7-15y and 1.2:1 in 15y+.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Demand for the 10y reopening was solid and the auction priced through the when-issued level, which supported rates.
A small tail after the 30y came into the auction 5 bps richer. Demand was adequate but not strong.

macro_indicators.reading: +137.5 bps, about 2 bps tighter on the week
macro_indicators.interpretation: French deficit concerns drove an initial widening that reversed after a flight to quality stabilized the market.
European crossover credit ended the week firmer despite the French spread volatility.

risk_factors: New and growing chip financing deals are adding hyperscaler credit supply and pressuring beta hyperscaler spreads.
Lower-than-expected OpenAI revenue headlines weigh on AI-linked credit.
The IG spread rally rests on macro strength rather than improving credit fundamentals.
Bid-offer is wide, with $100mm+ PTs clearing 2-3x wider than normal, which raises the cost of adding or cutting exposure.
French public deficit concerns can resurface in the OAT/Bund spread.
vol_and_positioning: Interest rate volatility is at 6-month highs.
The HYG - 3x LQD spread is at its widest since May, showing decompression between high yield and investment grade cash.
HY PT flow: clients are 2.4:1 net buyers of BB, 2.2:1 of B and 1.4:1 of CCC. IG PT flow: clients are 1.3:1 net sellers in A and up and in BBB.
The hyperscaler IG 30y basket spread to the ex-hyperscaler basket is at its widest since July.
geopolitical: Trump's announcement of a suspension of his attacks on Iran drove stocks higher.
Concerns over the mounting public deficit in France drove an initial widening in the OAT/Bund spread before a flight to quality stabilized it.

tension_points.bear_case: The desk says the move was driven largely by broader macro strength rather than strengthening credit fundamentals. IG PT clients were 1.3:1 net sellers and bid-offer widened.
